claim_text: The published NRRS signal can be partitioned into transportable prognostic information and neural, endothelial, fibroblast, epithelial, purity, MSI, and stage-associated components under explicit preprocessing choices.
biological_unit: Patient within an independent cohort; patient or tissue section for cellular and spatial validation
required_evidence: Frozen coefficients; cohort-independent validation roles; patient-level survival and covariates; negative-control cell programs; at least two public single-cell cohorts; conditional spatial evidence
claim_ceiling: Association and construct validity only; failure to support a neural construct is an admissible result
